summary: Comprehensive testing of the new visitor accounts feature (JWT). Backend: 12/12 auth endpoint tests passing (register, login, /me, /sync, /claim-admin, validation, JWT auth). Frontend: full E2E via Playwright — register from TopBar dialog, JWT stored in sx_token, autosave sync of favorites+preferences (6s), first-login migration of pre-existing local favorites to server, cross-device restore (localStorage cleared then re-login pulls server state back with a single reload — no infinite loop), claim-admin from Settings (correct PIN 1234 grants admin, 0000 rejected), logout clears token, guest dismiss via auth-guest, and Google button correctly starts the Emergent OAuth redirect chain. Test account testvisitor@stationexus.com/Test1234 verified.

issues: ProfilePrompt (data-testid=profile-prompt) overlays the whole app on first load, blocking clicks on TopBar login-btn until 'Plus tard' is used. Consider auto-dismissing when the AuthDialog is opened, or lowering its z-index/adding pointer-events management so the top bar is still reachable.

action_items: Optional UX: ProfilePrompt overlay intercepts pointer events over TopBar 'Se connecter' on fresh sessions. Not blocking (users can click 'Plus tard' or the dialog's own 'Créer mon profil'), but consider allowing TopBar login without dismissing the profile prompt first.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.finishAuth 'empty' branch does not call applyAccountAndReload; that's correct for first-login migration but relies on the server-returned user snapshot. Fine but a small comment would help future maintainers.
get_current_user rejects malformed/expired JWTs with 401 — good. Consider adding an index on users.email in Mongo to make the unique-ish email lookup safer under concurrency.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users with prefix qa_<uuid>@stationexus.test via /api/auth/register. Existing testvisitor@stationexus.com/Test1234 verified. One fresh QA user was claim-admin promoted for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth = JWT in localStorage sx_token. Autosave interval is 6s. Cross-device restore triggers a single window.location.reload() when the server returns non-empty preferences/favorites, gated by sessionStorage sx_auth_applied. When testing UI on a fresh session, dismiss ProfilePrompt (data-testid=profile-prompt-later) OR set localStorage.sx_profile_prompted='1' before interacting with TopBar. Also set sessionStorage sx_intro_shown=1 and sx_entered=1 to skip the boot intro. Google button redirects to auth.emergentagent.com which then chains to accounts.google.com — don't complete the flow.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional issues. Only observation: ProfilePrompt (z-[55]) overlays and can block TopBar clicks in automated tests; dismiss it explicitly.
